name: Sunflower Sanctuary
source:
a dark, bite-sized visual novel depicting the lives of two dysfunctional cult members in love. made by brown lesbians for brown lesbians.

[From [url=https://heavencult.itch.io/sunflower]itch.io[/url]]

一部黑暗的、一口大小的视觉小说，描绘了两个相爱的功能失调的邪教成员的生活。由棕色女同性恋者为棕色女同性恋者制作。

[来自[url=https://heavencult.itch.io/sunflower]itch.io[/url]]
